The name 'Jagatkar' is derived from the Sanskrit term 'Jagat', meaning 'world' and 'Kar', meaning 'doer' or 'ruler'. This name was commonly used by the Rajput rulers of the Jaisalmer region to signify their role as the rulers of the world (Jagat) in the medieval period of India.
